Why CMA

Not All Coaching Programs are Created the Same

When seeking a professional coaching certification, coach training course, or coaching education to enhance your skillset and elevate your confidence and effectiveness, it's essential to consider several key factors beyond just the affordability of the course fee. A holistic approach will help you make the best personal and professional development decisions.

Internationally Recognized Certification

A Professional Coaching Certification that meets rigorous academic standards.

The International Coaching Federation (ICF) is the leading global organisation dedicated to advancing coaching standards and practices and regulating coaching practices. Our coaching program has been approved by the prestigious International Coaching Federation (ICF) and endorsed by Alexandra University in Romania as part of their Master’s Programme in Organizational Coaching.

Our accolades, including being named "Best Coaching Impact" by the ICF, "Best Coach Training Provider” in APAC, and “Best Education Provider,” reflect our commitment to setting high standards and leading the coaching industry.

With our internationally recognised certification, you can confidently embark on your coaching journey, knowing that you are equipped with a qualification that meets academic standards and is approved by the International Coaching Federation (ICF).

Coaching Methodology

Bridging Coaching with Science A Proprietary Coaching Framework for Success

We are pioneering a new frontier in the coaching industry with a transformational approach that is backed by science. Our proprietary coaching approach redefines conventional methods, blending human psychology with coaching psychology to inspire meaningful change in every conversation. This distinctive framework empowers us to stand out in the coaching field.

You gain credibility and confidence in facilitating a meaningful change conversation.

Join us and become part of a pioneering movement shaping the future of coaching through science-based practices.

Comprehensive Training Design

Well-Structured Instructional Design focusing on competency development

Unlike most coaching training courses that offer circumlunar learning, our program follows a deliberate, phased learning approach.

The program comprises various labs designed to help participants become skilled practitioners. Each lab has a unique focus and purpose to provide a well-rounded learning experience - from grasping core concepts to real-world application. Each learning phase is meticulously designed to support you in delivering a transformational impact in your coaching intervention.

The Learning Lab aims to improve and deepen your understanding of the application. You will explore the theoretical frameworks that underpin the methodology while identifying the factors that enhance the effectiveness of the principles involved.

The Competency Lab is designed to help bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge learned in the classroom and practical application. This initiative focuses on hands-on methods, showing you how you can effectively apply the concepts.

The Practical Lab enhances understanding of the methodology by using real-world case studies to effectively demonstrate its application. You will gain valuable practical expertise, enabling you to confidently and proficiently initiate coaching efforts.

The Mentoring Lab, alongside the Practical Lab, offers personalized, detailed feedback from a qualified Coach Supervisor. This customized mentorship aims to enhance your skills and deepen your understanding of the methodology, supporting advanced learning and application of the approach.

The Enrichment Lab provides you with a unique opportunity to observe live demonstrations led by our Master Coaches. They will showcase their expertise in managing complex real-world situations. This hands-on learning platform allows for a deeper understanding and skill development that goes beyond traditional classroom instruction.

Continual Professional Development

Unwavering dedication to Your Developmental Growth

Choosing a coaching education provider is more than just obtaining a qualification. At CMA, our commitment to your formative development is a cornerstone of our coaching education, ensuring that your ongoing development extends well beyond our formal training.

We help you grow through enriching learning opportunities and ensure you have the support and community you need to thrive in your coaching career and practice.

  • Weekly Enrichment Learning
    These sessions present a powerful opportunity to observe live coaching demonstrations by our Master Coaches, showcasing advanced techniques in real scenarios and significantly enhancing practical understanding beyond traditional classrooms.
  • Masterclass
    Explore the exciting world of human science with our masterclasses. Designed to enhance your knowledge and skills, these sessions keep you abreast of the latest trends and developments in coaching practices.
  • Retreat & Conference
    A successful coach must prioritise their well-being. Our retreats & conferences provide a sanctuary for rejuvenation and personal growth, enhancing the skills needed to support clients effectively.
Ever-Expanding Global - Local Support Community

We Are an Active, Thriving Community

Joining Coach Masters Academy means being a part of our global community of passionate practitioners dedicated to personal and organisational transformation. As coach practitioners, we focus not only on guiding others but also on our growth. This thriving community enhances your journey of self-improvement, providing support and inspiration from experienced coaches and like-minded individuals.

  • You can have invaluable opportunities for peer learning, sharing best practices, and collaboration for business opportunities.
  • You will have a supportive network that fosters resilience and prevents burnout, which are crucial factors in maintaining a coach's effectiveness and longevity.

In essence, a vibrant coaching community is not just a nice to have but an essential component in a coach's journey where you can renew their passion and expand your network to learn, grow and contribute meaningfully.
